caption:
Christmas shutdown's coming. The tools go down, but the phone keeps ringing: leaks, dead aircon, gates that won't shut.
If those calls go to voicemail for a fortnight, some of that work can end up with someone else.
TradeReach texts each missed caller back within moments, says it's automated, asks what they need and keeps every job in your dashboard for when you're back.
👉 See how it works at tradereach.net
